blocks.title: Alkanes
blocks.text: Alkanes aam formula CnH2n+2 wale saturated hydrocarbons hain. Methane, CH4, is khandan ka sab se saada rukn hai.

Alkane se ek hydrogen atom hatane par jo milta hai woh alkyl group hai, jis ka naam alkane ke -ane ko -yl se badal kar rakha jata hai: methane se methyl, CH3- (Me-), aur ethane se ethyl, CH3CH2- (Et-) (Table 11.2). Do se zyada carbon atoms wale alkanes se ek se zyada alkyl groups nikal sakte hain (Table 11.3): propane se n-propyl (propyl) CH3CH2CH2- aur isopropyl (1-methylethyl) CH3CH(CH3)-; butane se n-butyl (butyl), sec-butyl (1-methylpropyl), isobutyl (2-methylpropyl) aur tert-butyl (1,1-dimethylethyl; print mein '1,1-dimethylpropyl'). Butane lighters ka fuel hai aur isobutane shaving gel mein propellant.

blocks.prompt: Eicosane 20 carbon atoms wala seedhi zanjeer ka alkane hai. Us ka molecular formula dein, aur 2-methylbutane aur 2,2-dimethylpropane ke structural formulas likhein (Quick Check 11.1a, d).
blocks.explanation: CnH2n+2 mein n = 20 se C20H42. 2-Methylbutane: CH3CH(CH3)CH2CH3, chaar carbon ki zanjeer carbon 2 par methyl ke saath. 2,2-Dimethylpropane: C(CH3)4, teen carbon ki zanjeer carbon 2 par do methyls ke saath; dono C5H12 hain.

items: Alkanes CnH2n+2, saturated, methane se decane (Table 11.1); har rukn CH2 ka farq rakhta hai.
Alkyl group = alkane manfi ek H, -ane se -yl: methyl, ethyl, n- aur isopropyl, n-, sec-, iso- aur tert-butyl.
